_comment: One glossary for all your videos. The entries below are the real RU -> UK ones the pipeline was built with; replace them with your own. asr_prompt: hint for Whisper with terms it tends to misspell. asr_fixes: regex fixes applied to the source transcript before translation (case-insensitive). keep: names never translated, written in Latin as is. terms: how to translate specific terms. drop_phrases: phrases Whisper hallucinates on music/silence; segments containing them are removed. pronounce: for the voice only; the translation keeps text, ElevenLabs/OmniVoice receive say.
asr_prompt: Claude Code, MCP, скиллы, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, API.

pronounce.why: the Latin spelling was mispronounced at 01:35

terms.note: loanword from English 'skill'; do not translate as «навичка»
